_readme: Voice-over via fal.ai TTS. Copy to ai/tts.json, then: node ../../tools/fal/tts.mjs --project . --dry (then without --dry). eleven = ElevenLabs v4 ($0.08/1k chars, Hebrew with lang he, voices Adam/Brian/Daniel/George); minimax = MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD ($0.10/1k chars, voices Determined_Man/Elegant_Man/Deep_Voice_Man, <#0.4#> pause tags). Outputs: ai/audio/<id>.mp3. Read every take back with transcribe.mjs before using it. AI voice must be disclosed at the start of the video.

jobs.text: שלום, זו בדיקת קול קצרה. <#0.4#> המשפט השני מגיע אחרי הפסקה.
